## Scope
- **#17**: AI-native end-of-Phase reconciliation against **live GitHub Project items**, linked Issues, PR/CI, main SHA and verified acceptance. Correct status/scope drift, close only evidence-backed completions, keep FAIL/PARTIAL blocks, discover Project fields/permissions instead of guessing.
- **#18**: default ADS consumption as a **pinned `.ads` Git Submodule**; short root AGENTS.md; safe private repo access; agent-native update triggers (owner request, Phase checkpoint, optional configured schedule). Diff approved immutable releases, update consumer gitlink via tested PR. Normal `git submodule update --init` **does not advance** the parent pin.
- Add canonical `docs/milestone-reconciliation.md`, `docs/how-to-update.md`; amend bootstrap/adopt/deliver/recover Skills, standard, quality, adoption docs, AGENTS template and acceptance scenario index.
- Include failure cases: private access, dirty submodule, unavailable GitHub Project API, false Done, security FAIL/PARTIAL, upgrade rollback.

## Evidence and boundaries
Normative documentation and workflows only. **No live GitHub Project item reconciliation or cross-repository consumer submodule test has run** in this PR. Neither Issue should close automatically when the docs PR merges; both retain acceptance scenarios. No mandatory daemon, scheduled workflow, third-party updater or new CLI. No existing repository is auto-migrated; no ADS release/tag is created, no production deployment or global settings mutation.

## Verification
Let Validate ADS run doc/Skill and unit checks on the exact PR HEAD. Review links, example safety, default pin behavior and migration assumptions. Then complete live isolated acceptance and close #17/#18 only when actual tests support it.
